applyDialog.title: Leave Application
applyDialog.description: Fill out the leave application form. It will be submitted to your supervisor for approval.
applyDialog.reasonPlaceholder: Briefly describe the reason for leave
applyDialog.attachment: Supporting Document (recommended for this leave type)
applyDialog.lunchBreakHint: The system automatically excludes any time that overlaps with the 12:00–13:00 lunch break from the calculated hours.

applications.listDescription: Leave application records and review status for all employees

reviewDialog.grantHintBefore: This application is linked to a leave grant. Remaining:
reviewDialog.grantHintAfter: days (granted {{total}} days, deadline {{deadline}}). Approved days cannot exceed the remaining balance.
reviewDialog.compHintAfter: hours. Approved hours cannot exceed the remaining balance (deducted automatically starting from the nearest deadline).
reviewDialog.approvedDaysLabel: Approved Days (adjustable based on supporting documents, e.g. bereavement leave days based on relationship)
reviewDialog.reviewNotePlaceholderReject: Explain the reason for rejection; the employee will see this note

applyDialog.title: Overtime Application
applyDialog.description: Fill out the overtime application form. It will be submitted to your supervisor for approval.
applyDialog.reasonPlaceholder: Briefly describe the reason for overtime
applyDialog.compHint: Per Article 32-1 of the Labor Standards Act, comp time is converted 1:1 with hours worked. It must be used within 6 months of the overtime date; any portion not used by then will be converted to overtime pay.
applyDialog.lunchBreakHint: The system automatically excludes any time that overlaps with the 12:00–13:00 lunch break from the calculated hours.

overtime.listDescription: Overtime application records and review status for all employees

reviewDialog.reviewNotePlaceholderReject: Explain the reason for rejection; the employee will see this note

balance.title: Employee Leave Balance
balance.description: View each employee's remaining leave days
balance.recalculate: Recalculate Annual Leave by Join Date

adjustDialog.title: Adjust Leave Balance
adjustDialog.annualUsedLabel: Annual Leave Used Days (available days ({{days}}) are calculated automatically from the join date; only "used" can be adjusted here)
adjustDialog.noActivePeriod: This employee has no annual leave anniversary record yet, so it cannot be adjusted
adjustDialog.compHint: Comp time available/used hours are now calculated automatically from approved overtime and leave usage, and can no longer be adjusted manually. See "Comp Time Details" for the source.

settlement.title: Annual Leave Settlement
settlement.description: Annual leave anniversary periods that are due but not yet settled. Per Article 38 of the Labor Standards Act, unused days newly granted this period may be carried over once or cashed out; days carried over from the previous period that remain unused must be cashed out in full.
settlement.empty: No pending anniversary periods to settle

settleDialog.title: Settle Annual Leave Anniversary
settleDialog.mandatoryLabel: Mandatory cash-out (unused carry-over from last period):
settleDialog.optionalLabel: Optional carry-over or cash-out this period:
settleDialog.carryOverLabel: Days to carry over to the next period (the rest will be cashed out automatically)
settleDialog.noSalary: Monthly salary not set; cannot estimate

compSettlement.title: Comp Time Settlement
compSettlement.description: Comp time entitlements that are overdue (more than 6 months past the overtime date) and still unused. The remaining hours must be fully cashed out as overtime pay.
compSettlement.empty: No pending comp time entitlements to settle

compExpiringSoon.title: Comp Time Expiring Soon
compExpiringSoon.description: Comp time entitlements expiring within 30 days that are still unused and not yet overdue. Consider reminding employees to schedule time off.
compExpiringSoon.empty: No comp time entitlements expiring soon

grants.formDescription: For leave types such as bereavement or marriage leave that involve "multiple leave requests for the same event." After verifying the employee's supporting documents, grant the total days and deadline directly. Subsequent leave applications from the same employee for the same leave type will automatically be deducted from this grant, and applications exceeding the remaining balance will be blocked.
grants.notePlaceholder: e.g. Father's passing, 8 days granted based on relationship
grants.recordsDescription: Granted leave entitlements and usage status

types.title: Leave Type Settings
types.description: Manage the leave types and rules in the system

The file's column headers must stay in the original Chinese as published by the government — the system matches them by those exact Chinese labels, e.g. below.

holidays.calendarHoverHint: Hover over a date to see the holiday name
holidays.listDescription: Imported public holidays, make-up workdays, and regular workdays
